_comment: Authentic test datasets, published as GitHub Release assets on barricklab/CNery.
One release per dataset version, tagged testdata-<name>-v<N>, carrying a single .tar.gz.
Adding or revising a dataset touches only its own entry here -- no other dataset is
The sha256 -- not the tag -- is what makes a dataset immutable. If an asset is replaced
in place, the hash check fails loudly rather than silently changing what the tests run on.
Generate an entry with:  python tests/data/add_testdata.py <folder> --name <name>
Fetch during tests with: pytest -m authentic

ltee_ara_p1_50k_shift.description: LTEE Ara+1 50k-generation coverage table against a circularly permuted REL606 reference; no BAM

ltee_ara_m3_32k_2rg.description: LTEE Ara-3 32k generations, two read groups; 26-column table with a 10-line footer

ltee_ara_m3_38k.description: LTEE Ara-3 38k generations, one read group; 18-column table with a 7-line footer

ltee_ara_p5_75k_exp.description: LTEE Ara+5 75k generations, exponential phase; --total-only 5-column table with a 4-line footer; the only dataset where OTR correction fires

cwbi_ssym_ht04.description: Symbiont CWBI HT-04 gen 30; chromosome plus two multi-copy plasmids as CSV --total-only tables; the only multi-sequence and only CSV dataset

adp1_mgd06_lb.description: Acinetobacter baylyi ADP1-ISx, MGD06 LB clone E02; 3.59 Mb reference, TSV --total-only; the first non-REL606 genome
